name: Online Link
description: Point-to-point Opus audio link between two studios — create a link, send the URL to a friend, pick TX or RX, and every mode flows online. Optional channel-conditions simulator (noise floor, QSB fading, QRN crashes, hum, filters) plus a full virtual-rig propagation mode: live NOAA solar data, your two locations, band, power and antennas decide whether the signal makes the trip. Learn and experiment for hours without putting a single watt on the air.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
